name: indicator_id
description: Stable identifier of the indicator built as a hash of the source table number and the full row-stub path
observations: Primary key; the ABS release carries no series identifiers so this is derived. Stable across releases unless the ABS rewords a row label

name: table_no
description: Number of the source ABS 5260.0.55.002 table the indicator is published in

name: industry_code
description: ANZSIC 2006 division letter of the industry the indicator refers to
observations: Null for indicators that are not industry-specific. No ANZSIC directory exists in Data Basis yet; intended FK is a future br_bd_diretorios_au.anzsic_division:id_division, matching au_abs_labour_force which also stores the division inline

name: state_id
description: Code of the Australian state or territory the indicator refers to
observations: Null for national indicators. Only the experimental state tables 27 to 42 are state-specific

name: table_name
description: Name of the source ABS table as published in the workbook contents

name: table_group
description: Whether the source table is an official or an experimental ABS estimate
observations: One of standard (tables 1 to 19), experimental_industry (20 to 26) and experimental_state (27 to 42). The ABS publishes tables 20 to 42 as experimental

name: section
description: Top-level block heading the indicator sits under within its source table
observations: Distinguishes measure families within one table, for example Indexes of productivity and related measures against Percentage changes to productivity indexes

name: item
description: Leaf label of the indicator as published in the row stub

name: item_path
description: Full row-stub hierarchy of the indicator joined with a greater-than sign
observations: Preserves the source nesting verbatim, for example Multifactor productivity > Hours worked basis. The parsed industry, state, basis and unit columns are derived from it

name: industry_name
description: Name of the ANZSIC 2006 division the indicator refers to
observations: Null for indicators that are not industry-specific. Normalised to a single spelling per division; the ABS capitalises two division names inconsistently across tables

name: state_name
description: Name of the Australian state or territory the indicator refers to

name: basis
description: Labour input basis the indicator is measured on
observations: Hours worked or Quality adjusted hours worked (QALI), which weights hours by education and experience. Null where the distinction does not apply

name: unit
description: Unit of measure of the indicator
observations: Derived from the section heading and table title. One of Index, Percentage change, Percentage point contribution, Proportion, $ million and Index of prices

name: first_financial_year
description: Australian financial year of the first observation of the indicator in YYYY-YY format

name: last_financial_year
description: Australian financial year of the last observation of the indicator in YYYY-YY format
